open Polynomial
#check_failure Roth.sum_natDegree_update_lt
namespace DegreeUpdateGuards
theorem constant_guard :
    ¬ (1 - C ((1 : ℚ[X]).leadingCoeff / (1 : ℚ[X]).leadingCoeff) * 1 : ℚ[X]).natDegree <
      (1 : ℚ[X]).natDegree := by simp

theorem unequal_degree_guard :
    ((X ^ 2 + 1) - C ((X ^ 2 + 1 : ℚ[X]).leadingCoeff / (X : ℚ[X]).leadingCoeff) * X).natDegree =
      (X ^ 2 + 1 : ℚ[X]).natDegree := by
  compute_degree!
#print axioms constant_guard
#print axioms unequal_degree_guard
end DegreeUpdateGuards
